description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. No internal corridor — fully open layout. Kitchen: unclear, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: A single armchair near the centre-left of the living zone, oriented toward the open space; a dining table with chairs sits along the top wall.. Entry: direct into living, first thing visible on arrival is living area. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Studio apartment. Unclear bed. Bed partially visible from front door, partially visible from kitchen. Sleeping alcove offers slight visual separation but cooking smells reach the sleeping area. Storage: no wardrobe — very limited storage. One bathroom (shower and toilet). Bathroom accessed directly from the living area — no private corridor. Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples comfortable with combined living and sleeping space. Not suitable for: families with children (studio with no separate bedrooms); couples needing private separate sleeping space; people needing significant storage (no wardrobe noted); remote workers needing a dedicated office (no desk or separate room).
